Prerequisites: VIO 3, SPI 2

In the Revolution, the Asuri Sect take on the role of the militant vanguard. Those that need to be in the frontlines to be able to strike a blow against the enemy. They are the prime example of demonic forces being used for the emancipation of all humanity. And whoʼs to say that demonkind are not subject to the targeted propaganda of bourgeois media and ideology? The Asuri Demon Sect steal away the Sidhi that has been stolen from them since the beginning.

The Asuri is trained to be emboldened against greater numbers. Any dice penalties from her Health Sutra are converted into bonus dice instead. When she is Bloody, she gets +1 instead of -1, and +3 instead of -3 if she's Critical.

More than just anger, the Asuri Sect wields explosive libido—that is, Desire, not just in the sexual sense—as a poison from which the antidote can be cured.

The Asuri can speak the language of chaos and demonkind. She is no longer susceptible to any fear-based or intimidation-based influences and can feasibly use her VIO to speak with other entities. IF SHE HAS THE DEVIL CRUCIBLE: Her Killing Intent aura can now affect entities 2 Stages above her. All entities within her Killing Intent also now suffer -1 DEF.

The practice of concocting, boiling, forging, and crafting pills, elixirs, and other alchemical reagents and items to strengthen oneʼs body in an attempt to attain immortality. Prerequisites: VIO 7, GRC 6, SIDHI 3, DIALECTICAL CITIPATI

Memorize all the possible cuts, and choose which to negate. Kafeng Masangwaʼs daughter, Reni Tirakadiz, was the one that finished the last techniques of her Red Sword Manual. When she finished it, both her arms fell off her sockets, and she became blinded.

[✹✹] Activate on an Attack: the Sword Dialectician makes three different attacks as three different possibilities erupt from a single attack. She then chooses which Attack is “real” and the superposition collapse, the possibilities are negated into the a real, concrete thing—she chooses the real Attack as the actual Attack Check’s result. If the attack is a Dual Attack, roll the three possibilities on top of the two main checks, so 5 Attack Checks in all.

system.description:
Prerequisites: DIA 3, WRD 2

You have heard the lies. The Five-Armed Demiurge Array made Cultivation impossible for the common people. This is true for the safe paths, the obedient paths, the paths that the Immortals permit. But the Ultramystic path is not safe. It is not obedient. It does not require Magnetite hoarded in corporate vaults. It requires struggle. It requires the friction of bodies against the machinery of Capital, the heat of collective action, the pure, unalloyed violence that arises when the wretched of the earth decide they will no longer be wretched.

[❂][✦] Establish a Consciousness Thread to a willing listener. Through this thread, the Ultramystic can share emotions, coordinate actions, telepathically communicate, and even offer up Ardor should they need it. Any Action that is coordinated through the Consciousness Thread benefits from a +2 to the Check. This includes coordinating someone to attack.

Prerequisites: DIA 4, VIO 3, SIDHI 1

In the Revolutionary Era, the Arch-Revolutionary Kafeng Masangwa attained some modicum of Omniscience by solidifying her materialist doctrine of Scientific Communism. The followers of Masangwa wield the Sword of Dialectics to cut through contradiction and find the ultimate Resolution at the heart of things, which is sublation, which is nonduality.

[✹✹✹][✦] The Cultivator barks out a scything command. Whatever the word is, its power is imbued with Persuasive Sidhi, and all those that hear must stop. All beings of choice by the Cultivator she must make a DIA vs SPI Opposed Check against. On those she wins against, they are Stopped: they cannot move voluntarily and cannot take any Actions. Every 6 seconds that pass, she must make another DIA vs SPI opposed check again. If she wins, they stay stopped. If she loses, they can move.
